objective: Start the source-only F124/F126 executor on the first actual scheduled-main run even when F125/F127/F128 predecessors do not yet exist; admit downstream stages only from earlier completed successful scheduled-main dual-OS evidence, and demonstrate cross-platform admission equivalence.
schedule: Only existing forge-integrated-synthetic-cycle.yml six-hour cron; no new scheduler.

admission.PR: Run all bounded source-only stages against PINNED authentic PR evidence; mark non-scheduled development; never claim unattended.
admission.SCHEDULE: Only prior successful complete attempt-1 scheduled run on main of this integrated workflow, with exact GitHub source SHA, no partial/duplicate OS artifact pairs, nonexpired artifact identities, no source fallback.
admission.range: Last 40 earlier completed successful main scheduled runs, artifacts per run <=100, sorted by run ID descending; refuse incomplete API indices.
admission.bootstrap: F124 and F126 run on all events. F125, F127 and F128 are individually skipped on schedule until each prior stage has both OS artifacts. Only actually executed stages upload their artifacts.
admission.qualification: Fail on half-available prior OS pairs. Emit exact receipt per OS for stage admission; dependent job proves byte identity. Actual code in each stage separately revalidates extracted SHA receipts and original science-denial fields.
